facts.what: 回程沉默；问路时 George 只叹气、看窗外，让她自己找
facts.anchor: he’d huff a little bit more, pretend to focus on something outside, and leave me to figure it out myself.

facts.what: 认定 Maria 进门前就讨厌她；George 一次也没替她说话，是盔甲第一道裂缝
facts.anchor: It’s the first chink in the armour I’ve witnessed

facts.what: 回家后踢她脱下的衣服，指责皮裤、靴子、上衣暴露
facts.anchor: ‘You know, leather leggings…wasn’t one of your best choices, was it?

facts.what: 称母亲今天费了心，Blair 回怼后他摔门而出
facts.anchor: ‘She went to a lot of effort for you today, by the way,’ he continues.

facts.what: 取消她的中餐外卖，理由是她浪费了午餐
facts.anchor: ‘And it’s not going to. I cancelled your order.

facts.what: 光脚拎靴溜出门，叫 Uber 去旧酒吧找同事喝酒，想让他紧张
facts.anchor: I’m heading straight to the bar I used to work at to have some fun of my own.

facts.what: 等车时参加抽奖，最新一条不在舒适区仍点了参与
facts.anchor: The one my thumb is hovering over now is a bit out of my comfort zone

facts.what: 在 Uber 旁截住她，令司机取消，道歉并领她回家；手指扣紧她上臂
facts.anchor: ‘It’s all right, mate. Just cancel this one,’ George says

relations: Blair 与 George 同居，冲突升级；她尝试离开又被带回
